product_metadata.title: FLYINGCOLORS Kitchen Silicone Stove Counter Gap Cover - Set of 2 - Stove Gap, Gap for stoves, White
features: Set of 2 durable, pliable, heat-resistant food-grade silicone counter seam products, measurement : 17'' (L) x 2 1/6 ''(W), thickness: 2mm.
Bridges the gap between stove and counter, washer and dryer, desk and printer and more.
Prevent crumbs and other small items from falling in the gap and out of reach of cleaning
T-shape makes for easy installation and removal for cleaning and secures your cover in place
Covers are durable, heat resistant to 390 degrees Fahrenheit (230 Celsius), won't warp, and are top shelf dishwasher safe. Can be cut to fit your counter.
